verdict.rationale: Abacum's own materials say it builds the P&L, balance sheet and cash flow from live ERP actuals and offers real-time consolidation of the three statements with drill-down to source data. That directly covers both halves of the story. The evidence is short marketing copy, not detailed documentation. Missing for 10: detailed docs showing drill-down works from any figure down to individual source transactions or records, and independent or hands-on confirmation of the drill-down.

support.subject: As a finance lead, the model produces P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow views with drill-down from any figure to its source records

citations.quote: Abacum builds P&L, balance sheet and cash flow off live actuals from your ERP, so the numbers are current when someone asks and traceable when they question them.
Real-time consolidation of the three statements with drill-down to source data.
